source_text.body:
Get a morning phone call briefing and email follow-up reminders
An OpenClaw agent checks weather, calendar and news at 8am and calls the user with a summary, and watches email for specific replies or confirmations to remind them about.
·
Mar 2, 2026
Done with
OC
OpenClaw
What they did
The poster set up an OpenClaw automation to run at 8am, check weather, calendar, and a couple of news sources, then place a phone call with a spoken summary. They also connected email and told the agent what specific reply or confirmation to watch for on each heartbeat; when it saw one, it called with a quick summary. In comments, the poster says they used a ChatGPT subscription plus clawr.ing for phone-calling, and that OpenClaw's cron and web monitoring were built in.
How it went
The source presents it as part of a group of automations the poster kept because they were useful, mainly saving them from checking multiple apps and notifications. It gives no hard performance metrics or failure rates.
Worth knowing
The main catch mentioned is cost: the poster says this setup was cheaper with a ChatGPT subscription and clawr.ing than when using OpenRouter.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
Every day at [time, e.g. 8am], check the weather for [my city], my calendar, and top news on [topics], then call me at [phone number] and read a short summary. Also watch my email for [specific replies or confirmations I'm waiting on] and remind me when they arrive or if they haven't by [deadline]. Before sending any message or making any purchase on my behalf, show me what you plan to do and wait for my okay.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/openclaw/comments/1rj00va/my_openclaw_agent_calls_me_every_morning_now_and
